Steps to Prepare for Relay Testing

items:
This procedure is used to perform off 
 load relay test.
The test is divided into two tests

The AC test to determine pick up and 
 reset voltage.

The DC test to determine the operating 
 time.
Connect the circuit as shown in fig. 1.

Isolate the wire connected to pin 23at the 
 relay.

Switch on the Sverker and adjust the voltage 
 to100V.
Turn off the Sverker.
Connect the wire to pin 23 at the relay.

Switch on the Sverker to apply the 100 v to 
 the relay then check that the relay reset.

Slowly decrease the voltage until the relay 
 picks up and closes its contact.
This is the pick up voltage.

disconnect the trip signals from stop points 
 at the severker.

Slowly raise the voltage until the relay 
 resets and open its contact.
This is the reset voltage.
Switch off the Sverker.
Repeat the steps above for phase B and C

Preliminary 
Steps to Prepare for Relay Testing
This procedure is used to perform off 
 load relay test.
The test is divided into two tests
The AC test to determine pick up and 
 reset voltage.
The DC test to determine the operating 
 time.
AC Test - 
Phase A
Connect the circuit as shown in fig. 1.
Isolate the wire connected to pin 23at the 
 relay.
Switch on the Sverker and adjust the voltage 
 to100V.
Turn off the Sverker.
Connect the wire to pin 23 at the relay.
Switch on the Sverker to apply the 100 v to 
 the relay then check that the relay reset.
Slowly decrease the voltage until the relay 
 picks up and closes its contact.
This is the pick up voltage.
disconnect the trip signals from stop points 
 at the severker.
Slowly raise the voltage until the relay 
 resets and open its contact.
This is the reset voltage.
Switch off the Sverker.
Repeat the steps above for phase B and C
Note for phase B voltage points 25 & 26 and stop 6 & 8 
 for phase C voltage points 27 & 28 and stop 10 & 12
DC Test
Connect the circuit as shown in fig. 2.
Isolate the wire connected to pin 14 at the 
 timer MVTT14.
Switch on the Sverker and adjust the DC 
 voltage to 110 v.
Turn off the Sverker.
Connect the wire to pin 14 at the timer 
 MVTT14.
Reset the timer of the Sverker.
Switch on the Sverker to apply the 110 v DC 
 to the timer .
Check that the timer picks up and closes its 
 contact after the shown time on the LCD of the Sverker.
This is pick up time compare it with the 
 setting time.
